Intel XED AVX512-FP16 source

Repository: https://github.com/intelxed/xed
Revision: 0bcb6237345c5066726dcc08b3d87928df3b5b26
Original directory: datafiles/avx512-fp16/
Files prefixed avx512f- come from datafiles/avx512f/ (prefix removed).
License: Apache-2.0 (unmodified LICENSE included).

All .txt data files are unmodified original bytes. xed_fp16.go embeds the ISA
file; width, disp8, RC/SAE and feature normalizations follow the pinned companion
files. Unknown pattern grammar fails closed. All 590 source blocks are imported.
Embedded RC uses physical LL independently of logical VL128/VL512. Generated
crates retain this source notice and the original Intel XED license.
